summary: Master the essentials of internal auditing with our course focused on risk assessment, planning, and controls. Boost your expertise and career today.
lede: Internal auditing helps assurance, governance, and risk professionals assess organizational risks and evaluate controls. Participants explore risk identification and prioritization, risk-based audit planning, control testing, and clear reporting, including how to use risk registers and heat maps, assess control design and effectiveness, and document evidence and practical recommendations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals involved in assurance, governance, and risk oversight across various sectors. It caters to those who safeguard resources, assess risk, strengthen controls, and assure management of operational integrity.
audience: Internal control and quality assurance officers
modules: Common Control Failures and Red Flags
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of business operations and familiarity with organizational processes. Prior exposure to auditing or risk management concepts is beneficial but not mandatory.
